title: Exact Energy Levels
description: Essential Criteria: The exact energy levels must be correctly derived and presented in the final answer format.

title: First Order Approximation
description: Essential Criteria: The first order energy levels in terms of epsilon over k must be accurately calculated and presented.

title: Hamiltonian Formulation
description: Important Criteria: The Hamiltonian must be correctly formulated, including all potential terms and constants.

title: Variable Substitution
description: Important Criteria: The transformation of variables from x1, x2 to y1, y2 must be correctly applied and justified.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Any sign errors in the energy level expressions or Hamiltonian formulation will result in a deduction.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: All units in the final expressions should be consistent and correctly represented.

title: Limiting Cases
description: Optional Criteria: The response should discuss limiting cases or assumptions made during derivation.
